blockers.required_input: The authors' dataset or archived measurement artifact for the claimed 12 ms completion time under configuration A is absent. What is the source of the original measurement data, and can it be supplied or referenced?

What are the exact parameters of 'fixed configuration A' (e.g., topology, link capacities, queue sizes, protocol, workload specification, number of flows) needed to reproduce the 12 ms flow completion time?

Which registered runner (emulated-netem-v1 or real-world-iperf-v1) and what specific experimental protocol were used to obtain the original 12 ms measurement, so that a matching reproduction can be designed?
